title: Bernanke, Boivin and Eliasz (2005) FAVAR panel
notes: 120 transformed macro series (BBE Table A.1 transformation codes already applied) plus the fed funds rate. Variable descriptions in bbe2005-variables.csv.

title: Blanchard and Quah (1989) output growth and unemployment
notes: Demeaned/detrended series as used in the paper: real GNP growth and the unemployment rate.

title: Gertler and Karadi (2015) monetary VAR with high-frequency instruments
notes: Log CPI, log IP, policy rates, Treasury yields, Gilchrist-Zakrajsek EBP, mortgage and CP spreads. ff_exp1yr is NA before 1983.

title: Stock and Watson (2001) three-variable VAR
notes: Inflation (annualised QoQ), unemployment and the fed funds rate, 1960Q1-2000Q4.

title: Uhlig (2005) sign-restriction monetary VAR
notes: Real GDP (interpolated), CPI, commodity prices, fed funds, non-borrowed and total reserves.

title: Phillips, Shi and Yu (2015) S&P 500 price-dividend ratio
notes: Real S&P 500 price and dividend from Shiller's data, price-dividend ratio and its 1973-01 = 100 index. Used in the `exuber` package.

title: Kilian and Lutkepohl (2017) textbook monetary VAR
notes: Real GDP growth, fed funds rate and inflation, 1954Q4-2007Q4 (Chapter 2).

title: Kilian and Lutkepohl (2017) textbook oil VAR
notes: Real oil price growth, inflation and real GDP growth, 1973Q1-2013Q2 (Chapter 2).

title: NBER business cycle reference dates
notes: Peak and trough months and contraction length in months. Handy for shading recessions in plots.

title: Ramey (2016) monetary shocks panel
notes: Handbook Section 3 data: log IP, unemployment, CPI, fed funds, commodity prices, consumption; Romer-Romer shocks (Wieland update to 2007), Gertler-Karadi surprises, Barakchian-Crowe and Sims-Zha shocks, GZ excess bond premium, Wu-Xia shadow rate, five Stock-Watson factors.

title: Ramey (2016) government spending panel
notes: Handbook Section 4 data: nominal NIPA components and deflators, hours, population, T-bill, CBO potential GDP, Ramey military news, Fisher-Peters excess returns, Ben Zeev-Pappa defense news.

title: Ramey (2016) technology shocks panel
notes: Handbook Section 5 data: Fernald TFP (raw and utilization-adjusted), business output and hours, relative price of investment, plus identified technology and news shocks from Francis et al., Beaudry-Portier, Barsky-Sims, Ben Zeev-Khan, JPT and Miyamoto-Nguyen.

title: Ramey (2016) tax shocks panel
notes: Handbook Section 4 data: real NIPA aggregates, tax receipts, Romer-Romer exogenous/endogenous tax changes, Mertens-Ravn unanticipated and anticipated tax shocks, Leeper-Richter-Walker tax expectations.

title: Ramey and Zubairy (2018) US historical fiscal data
notes: Quarterly government purchases (most series from 1889, population from 1875), GDP, deflator, unemployment, military news, T-bill, ZLB dummy, potential GDP, debt and receipts. Standard dataset for state-dependent multipliers.

title: Gilchrist and Zakrajsek (2012) credit spread and excess bond premium
notes: GZ spread, excess bond premium and implied 12-month recession probability, updated monthly by the Fed Board. Snapshot taken 2026-09.
